text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar Crown Prince Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad ended a three-day visit to Tunisia. The two countries agreed to boost bilateral cooperation.
- Tehran expresses thanks to President Ben Ali for the aid sent to the earthquake victims in Iran.
- British businessmen started a one-week visit to Tunisia.
- Tunisian Parliament Speaker Habib Boulares on Monday held talks with visiting Argentinian counterpart Eduardo Menem on ways to boost bilateral cooperation.
- Equipment and Housing Minister Ali Chaouch says 20 bridges will be constructed during the next five years.
- Tunisian-Italian joint cooperation committee to hold soon its first meeting since 1991.
